name: contrast
description: Standard deviation of grayscale intensity values

name: entropy
description: Shannon entropy measuring color/intensity distribution randomness

name: edge_density
description: Ratio of Canny edge pixels to total image pixels

name: text_occupancy
description: Ratio of morphological binarized text pixels to total pixels

name: grid_hist_stats
description: Grid-cell histogram comparison scores statistics (mean, max, min, var, std) over NxN cells

name: whole_edge_density_diff

name: grid_edge_diff_stats
description: Absolute difference in cell edge density statistics (mean, max, min, var, std) over NxN cells

name: ssim_stats
description: Structural similarity index statistics (mean, min, variance) over grayscale dimensions

name: text_occupancy_diff
description: Absolute difference in morphological text occupancy ratios
